acceptance: The adopted wheel version and its upstream base are recorded, with proof it contains d30884dc.
The decision is recorded; if removed, the guard tests pass on that wheel and QuestDB tpchavoc passes in the next release or trunk UAT (run id recorded).
description:
#4339 added _case_flag_to_predicate in benchbox/utils/questdb_subqueries.py, which turns a WHERE conjunct CASE WHEN p THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 into p so SQLGlot 30.33 unnests the IN subquery for QuestDB again. Upstream answered tobymao/sqlglot#9190 with #9193 (merge d30884dc, 2026-11-18), which unnests membership in WHERE CASE conditions. It is not in v30.33.0. Once a benchbox-sqlglot wheel containing d30884dc is adopted, the pre-pass may be redundant. The not_before hold is a fallback; act earlier if such a wheel is adopted first.

Decision gate: when an adopted wheel's upstream base contains d30884dc, or at the hold date, choose keep or remove. Remove only if the adopted wheel produces the same 18_v10 QuestDB SQL without the pre-pass.

Guardrails: never remove before the adopted wheel contains d30884dc; test_tpchavoc_case_in_subquery_query_leaves_no_subquery_predicate and the not-exact-filter cases in tests/unit/platforms/test_questdb_subquery_rewrites.py stay either way.
